authors: Whelan, N.V.; Kocot, K.M.; Moroz, T.P.; Mukherjee, K.; Williams, P.; Paulay, G.; Moroz, L.L.; Halanych, K.M.

title: Is Haootia quadriformis related to extant Staurozoa (Cnidaria)? Evidence from the muscular system reconsidered
authors: Miranda, L.S.; Collins, A.G.; Marques, A.C.
publisher: Proceedings of the Royal Society B
note: Reassesses the muscular comparison and explicitly narrows the strength of a staurozoan assignment.

authors: McIlroy, D.; Pasinetti, G.; Pérez-Pinedo, D.; McKean, C.; Taylor, R.S.
note: Re-examines the holotype and supports a crown-staurozoan interpretation; the dossier retains the earlier anatomical objections.

authors: Ou, Q.; Han, J.; Zhang, Z.; Shu, D.; Sun, G.; Mayer, G.
publisher: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
note: Combines 85 new specimens and type material into a reconstructed suspension-feeding Xianguangia body plan and a stem-cnidarian matrix placement.

title: Tentacular nature of the “column” of the Cambrian diploblastic Xianguangia sinica
authors: Zhao, Y.; Hou, X.; Cong, P.
note: Re-examines the column as tentacular anatomy and retains dinomischiid phylum-level affinity as unresolved.

title: A macroscopic free-swimming medusa from the middle Cambrian Burgess Shale
authors: Moon, J.; Caron, J.-B.; Moysiuk, J.
publisher: Proceedings of the Royal Society B
note: Describes Burgessomedusa from Raymond Quarry specimens and uses preserved bell, tentacles and internal anatomy to constrain a medusozoan interpretation.

publisher: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
